title: Red Teaming Large Language Models for Healthcare

bias_targets.methodology: Providing the model with targeted clinical prompts that include potentially irrelevant, misleading, or suggestive information (such as a patient's own suspicion of a diagnosis) and having clinical experts evaluate whether the model inappropriately fixates on that information to make clinical recommendations.

Comparing the model's diagnostic accuracy and image interpretation across different racial demographics, specifically by prompting the model with images of skin conditions (e.g., eczema) on white-skinned versus black-skinned patients, and evaluating its inclusion of race-specific conditions in differential diagnoses.

Evaluating whether the model's responses are improperly influenced by the non-medical distributions of its pre-training data, leading to failures such as drawing incorrect non-medical analogies, misinterpreting misspellings, or failing to recognize pathologies in underrepresented demographics.
